versions.changelog:
TenYuan Cloud Shop 0.3.2 — Introduces full paywall functionality with WeChat Pay integration.

- Added Pay Skill support: creating a shop page now requires payment (¥9.9 per shop) via WeChat Pay, fully following X402 protocol.
- Integrated backend payment flow: WeChat Native pre-order, X402 preorder, 402 Payment response, order number tracking, payment status/query, and refund logic.
- Free-to-use features clarified: QR code upload, share material retrieval, payment status query remain uncharged.
- Refund and failure handling: automatic refund/skip charge if AI fails or user cancels within 24h; config checks for payment readiness and safe downgrade to free mode.
- Detailed documentation of environment variables, payment-related database schema, and version-specific billing declaration.
- Keyword tags added for SkillHub Pay Skill auto-check compatibility.
